{"id":2020133726,"question_id":42,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 month, 3 weeks","timestamp":1780400846,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"3 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2020133726/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Trapping Rain Water","memory":"27.5 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int trap(vector<int>& height) {\n        int n = height.size();\n\n        vector<int>leftmax(n) , rightmax(n);\n        leftmax[0] = height[0];\n        rightmax[n-1] = height[n-1];\n\n        for(int  i = 1 ; i<n ; i++) leftmax[i] = max(leftmax[i-1] , height[i]);\n        for(int  i = n-2 ; i>=0 ; i--) rightmax[i] = max(rightmax[i+1] , height[i]);\n\n        int water = 0;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            water += min(leftmax[i] , rightmax[i]) - height[i];\n        }\n        return water;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"trapping-rain-water","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2056}
